regulation.scope: Issuers of crypto-assets, crypto-asset service providers (CASPs), and trading platforms operating within the EU/EEA. Scope strictly restricted to code-detectable technical obligations.

rules.title: Safekeeping and segregation of client crypto-assets and private keys
rules.description: Crypto-asset service providers (CASPs) must implement arrangements for safekeeping clients' crypto-assets and private keys. CASPs must segregate client assets from their own assets, prevent commingling, and ensure client assets cannot be used for the CASP's own account. Private keys and cryptographic seed material must be stored in secure cryptographic hardware (HSM/KMS) and never stored in plaintext.
check_hints: Private keys or seed phrases stored in plaintext in database, configuration, or memory
No HSM, secure enclave, or KMS integration in key management path
Client private keys mixed with platform operational keys without segregation
Private keys or seed phrases logged in error messages or application logs
Duplicate walletService.send() calls indicating potential double-spend or commingled transfers
non_compliant_patterns: db.save(user_id, private_key=raw_key) — plaintext key in database
walletService.send(commingled_pool, amount) without client account segregation
rules.remediation_guidance: Store all private keys in dedicated HSM/KMS. Enforce multi-signature or threshold signature schemes. Strictly segregate client wallet vaults from platform operational funds.

rules.title: Transaction audit trail and operational record-keeping
rules.description: Crypto-asset service providers must maintain comprehensive, tamper-evident audit trails of all crypto-asset transactions, order operations, and wallet transfers. Audit logs must record transaction timestamps, counterparty addresses, amounts, and execution state transitions to enable retrospective regulatory reconstruction.
check_hints: walletService.send() or transfer() executed without preceding or accompanying audit log
Missing structured audit trail around crypto-asset transfer operations
Crypto wallet address fields processed without associated transaction audit records
Order execution or fund transfer without atomic logging of transaction ID and counterparty
non_compliant_patterns: order_book.execute(order) with no audit trail entry
Missing audit event emission on critical wallet state changes
rules.remediation_guidance: Implement atomic audit logging for every transfer and trade operation. Emit structured audit events containing transaction hash, counterparty address, amount, and timestamp to a tamper-resistant append-only sink.

rules.title: Market abuse detection, surveillance, and reporting
rules.description: Crypto-asset service providers operating trading platforms or executing orders must implement algorithmic systems and automated surveillance to detect, prevent, and report market abuse including insider dealing, market manipulation, front-running, and wash trading. Suspicious transactions must be flagged without delay.
check_hints: No pre-trade surveillance or anomaly detection logic in order-matching or trading pipelines
Wash trading or self-crossing checks absent from order validation logic
Order book queries or execution paths lacking rate limiting and front-running prevention
No automated suspicious transaction reporting (STR) hook or compliance alert queue
non_compliant_patterns: order_book.execute(order) with no pre-trade surveillance check
No self-match prevention check between buy and sell orders from same entity
Exposing raw order book depth without rate-limiting or spoofing detection
rules.remediation_guidance: Integrate trade surveillance module with pre-trade and post-trade checks. Detect self-trading/wash trades before matching. Enforce order rate-limiting and route anomalous trade alerts to a compliance monitoring queue.

rules.title: Travel Rule compliance and transaction threshold metadata
rules.description: Crypto-asset service providers must comply with the Transfer of Funds Regulation (Travel Rule) for crypto-asset transfers. Transfers exceeding statutory thresholds (e.g. >= 1,000 EUR or equivalent) must be accompanied by verified originator and beneficiary personal information (IVMS 101 standard). Transfers must be gated by customer identity verification (KYC).
check_hints: walletService.send() called without preceding customer KYC/identity verification
Transfer amount exceeding threshold (>= 1000) without originator or beneficiary metadata
Missing originator name, account identifier, or address in transfer payload
Absence of Travel Rule message dispatch alongside crypto transaction
non_compliant_patterns: walletService.send(dest, amount) without kycCheck() or verifyIdentity()
sendTransfer(dest, amount=5000) without originatorName or originatorAccount
Bypassing identity verification for high-value wallet transfers
rules.remediation_guidance: Gate all wallet transfer operations behind mandatory KYC verification. When transfer value meets or exceeds the regulatory threshold, validate and serialize required Travel Rule payload (originator and beneficiary names, account IDs) using standard IVMS 101 schemas.

missing_audit_log.title: No audit log around transfer operation
